text: Which consultancies in Sydney are best for business workflow automation and Microsoft Power Automate implementation?

result.keyword: Which consultancies in Sydney are best for business workflow automation and Microsoft Power Automate implementation?

items.markdown:
When looking for top-tier consultancies in Sydney specializing in business workflow automation and Microsoft Power Automate implementation, `several established local and national partners` stand out for their technical expertise, Microsoft certifications, and enterprise track records.

Leading consultancies servicing the Sydney market include:

- **SSW (Superior Software Windows)** — A premier Australian Microsoft Gold Partner with a strong presence in Sydney. They offer comprehensive [SSW Power Platform Consulting](https://www.ssw.com.au/consulting/power-platform) , specializing in connecting Power Automate with Power Apps, Power BI, and Azure services to build smooth, end-to-end organizational workflows.[[1]](https://www.ssw.com.au/consulting/power-platform)
- **CodeSource** — A Sydney-based consultancy focused on rapidly growing Australian enterprises. They provide dedicated [CodeSource Microsoft Power Platform Consulting](https://codesource.com.au/bespoke-software-development/microsoft-power-platform-and-power-apps-consulting-sydney/) covering multi-stage cloud workflow automations, custom data-entry apps, and complex back-office integrations using native and custom connectors.[[1]](https://codesource.com.au/bespoke-software-development/microsoft-power-platform-and-power-apps-consulting-sydney/)
- **Office Power** — An Australian specialist focusing heavily on modern workplace solutions, SharePoint, and the broader Microsoft 365 stack. Their Office Power Microsoft 365 Consulting team assists businesses with streamlining intranet workflows, automating document routing, and implementing custom forms via Power Automate and Power Apps.[[1]](https://officepower.com.au/)[[2]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHRIbCgNwdnESFENnMHZaeTh4TVhOamNqUTRiVFpvGAo)
- **Global & Enterprise Partners (e.g., Avanade, Insight, or Data#3)** — If you are a larger enterprise needing massive scale, governance frameworks, and change management alongside Power Automate, major tier-1 Microsoft partners with robust Sydney offices frequently handle enterprise-grade robotic process automation (RPA) and cloud flows. You can search and filter verified local credentials directly through the [Microsoft AppSource Partner Directory](https://www.microsoft.com/en-au/power-platform/products/power-automate/partners).[[1]](https://www.microsoft.com/en-au/power-platform/products/power-automate/partners)

To help narrow down the best fit, could you share:

- **The approximate size** of your organization or user base?
- **What systems or software** (e.g., ERP, CRM, legacy on-premise apps, Microsoft 365) the automated workflows need to connect with?
